reason: Pre-development checklist, spec index, and the per-change quality gate for backend work.
Required code patterns (annotations, frozen dataclasses, no print in runtime code), test organization and isolation rules, packaging rules for entry points, and the exact verification commands.
Module ownership, naming conventions, and import boundaries that decide where jev_gateway/cli/ lives and why it must not import gateway.py.
Existing error-naming and degradation conventions the CLI error codes and messages should follow.
Sensitive-data rules for logs; the background server log and secret handling must not leak credentials.
Authoritative provider and model field rules the CLI must satisfy when adding providers: type validation, api_base/api_key_env requirements, canonical model IDs, tags, and capabilities defaults.
Contracts for /healthz (auth, degraded status) and POST /v1/routing/reload used by jev status and jev config reload.
Current install methods and runtime-directory conventions the curl installer and docs must stay consistent with.
